name: Splunk — hunting playbook
description: Windows and network hunts built on Windows event codes and CIM fields. Set the index variable before running anything on a large deployment.

templates.name: Failed logons per account and source
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 earliest=-{{var:range}}
| stats count AS failures, dc(TargetUserName) AS accounts, values(Status) AS statuses, values(SubStatus) AS substatuses,
        min(_time) AS first_seen, max(_time) AS last_seen
        BY IpAddress
| where failures > 10
| convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort - failures

templates.name: Successful logon from a source that was failing
templates.description: Correlates 4625 and 4624 on the same source address.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4624) earliest=-{{var:range}}
| stats count(eval(EventCode=4625)) AS failures, count(eval(EventCode=4624)) AS successes,
        values(TargetUserName) AS accounts, min(_time) AS first_seen, max(_time) AS last_seen
        BY IpAddress
| where failures >= 20 AND successes > 0
| convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort - failures

templates.name: Accounts created or enabled
templates.description: Events 4720 and 4722, the persistence step after privilege escalation.

templates.name: Kerberos service tickets using RC4
templates.description: Event 4769 for non-machine SPNs using RC4 (0x17), a high-value Kerberoasting lead that still needs service-account baselining.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4769 earliest=-{{var:range}}
  ServiceName!="krbtgt" ServiceName!="*$" TicketEncryptionType=0x17
| stats count AS tickets, values(IpAddress) AS source_ips, min(_time) AS first_seen, max(_time) AS last_seen
        BY TargetUserName, ServiceName
| convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort - tickets

templates.name: PowerShell script blocks with encoded payloads
templates.description: Event 4104 script block logging. Requires script block logging to be enabled.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational" EventCode=4104 earliest=-{{var:range}}
| search ScriptBlockText IN ("*FromBase64String*", "*-EncodedCommand*", "*DownloadString*", "*Invoke-Expression*", "*WebClient*")
| table _time, host, UserID, ScriptBlockId, ScriptBlockText
| sort - _time

templates.name: Living off the land binaries executed
templates.description: Event 4688 or Sysmon 1, restricted to the usual suspects with a remote argument.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}} ((sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4688) OR (sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventCode=1))
| eval process_path=coalesce(NewProcessName, Image), parent_path=coalesce(ParentProcessName, ParentImage), account=coalesce(SubjectUserName, User)
| search process_path IN ("*\\certutil.exe", "*\\bitsadmin.exe", "*\\mshta.exe", "*\\regsvr32.exe", "*\\rundll32.exe", "*\\msiexec.exe")
         CommandLine IN ("*http://*", "*https://*", "*ftp://*", "*\\\\*")
| table _time, host, account, parent_path, process_path, CommandLine
| sort - _time

templates.name: Rare process names and hashes (tstats)
templates.description: A prevalence hunt over the Endpoint.Processes data model. Summary-only mode keeps it cheap; disable it when completeness matters more than speed.
templates.body:
| tstats summariesonly={{var:summariesonly}} allow_old_summaries={{var:allow-old-summaries}} count AS executions, dc(Processes.dest) AS hosts, values(Processes.parent_process_name) AS parents
  FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
  WHERE earliest=-{{var:range}}
  BY Processes.process_name, Processes.process_hash
| rename Processes.* AS *
| where executions < 10 AND hosts < 3
| sort executions, hosts

templates.name: Services installed
templates.description: Event 7045 from the System log, a persistence and lateral movement staple.

templates.name: Scheduled tasks registered
templates.description: Event 4698 plus the schtasks command line variant.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security" earliest=-{{var:range}} (EventCode=4698 OR (EventCode=4688 NewProcessName="*\\schtasks.exe"))
| table _time, host, SubjectUserName, TaskName, TaskContent, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| sort - _time

templates.name: Event logs cleared
templates.description: Events 1102 and 104. Rare, loud, and almost always worth an incident.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}} ((sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security" EventCode=1102) OR (sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:System" EventCode=104))
| table _time, host, SubjectUserName, Channel, EventCode, Message
| sort - _time

templates.name: Endpoint protection disabled or tampered with
templates.description: Defender configuration changes and exclusions added.

templates.name: Rarest user agents on the proxy
templates.description: Frequency analysis: malware rarely bothers to blend into the top of the list.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}} http_user_agent=*
| stats count AS requests, dc(src) AS clients, values(dest) AS destinations BY http_user_agent
| where requests < 20
| sort requests

templates.name: Long lived outbound sessions
templates.description: Beaconing and tunnels show up as unusually long or unusually regular sessions.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}} duration=*
| where duration > 3600
| stats count AS sessions, sum(duration) AS total_seconds, values(dest_port) AS ports BY src_ip, dest_ip
| sort - total_seconds
| head 100
